title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Furnished Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views in Business Bay, Dubai Business Bay is a vibrant and upscale district in the heart of Dubai, known for its dynamic mix of luxury residential towers, high-end hotels, and premium office spaces. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it offers breathtaking skyline views, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. With excellent connectivity via major highways and the metro, Business Bay attracts professionals, investors, and residents seeking a modern urban lifestyle with easy access to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street. The apartments are just 4 minutes from Business Bay Metro Station, 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera and Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The exterior features a sleek, contemporary design with stunning views of the Dubai skyline. The building is equipped with an infinity pool, Jacuzzi, kids' pool, aquatic gym, and pool deck seating, complemented by a BBQ area, kids' play area, and a variety of sports facilities including a cricket pitch, trampoline arena, wall climbing, basketball court, and tennis/cricket training courts. A wellness club, beauty salon, kids' daycare, snooker zone, and library provide additional comfort and relaxation. The upper levels boast exclusive amenities such as a sky observatory deck, sky meditation area, and both indoor and outdoor party halls, with a rooftop featuring a golf simulator, arcade zone, and family seating. The development also includes a business centre, indoor gyms, jogging track, bowling center, and outdoor cinema, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. The project features fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to offer a luxurious and contemporary living experience. The interiors are carefully curated with high-end finishes and attention to detail. The living spaces are spacious, with open layouts that seamlessly connect the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a perfect environment for relaxation and entertainment. Each apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and kitchen white goods, including a refrigerator, cooker, and washing machine, ensuring ease and functionality. The modern kitchens are designed with sleek cabinetry and high-quality materials for a sophisticated look. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. description: Verso is a contemporary residential development by Reportage Properties in Meydan, Dubai, offering one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments within a 15-storey tower. About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. title: Emaar Pier Point
description:
Pier Point is a waterfront residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential towers connected by a landscaped podium, offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, along with three-bedroom townhouses. Designed around contemporary architecture and marina-facing views, the development combines modern residential interiors with landscaped communal spaces and direct access to the waterfront promenade.
The apartments feature practical layouts with open-plan living and dining areas, kitchens, private balconies and dedicated utility spaces. One-bedroom residences include a bedroom, walk-in wardrobe, bathroom, living room and separate laundry area. Two-bedroom apartments provide additional living space, with a master bedroom featuring a walk-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom, a second bathroom and balconies in various layouts. Three-bedroom apartments offer larger interiors, spacious balconies, multiple bathrooms and additional utility or storage areas, with study spaces available in selected layouts.
The three-bedroom townhouses offer larger multi-level living arrangements, with three bedrooms, a maidâs room, multiple bathrooms, storage areas, laundry facilities and private outdoor spaces. These layouts provide additional flexibility for families seeking more space within a waterfront residential community.
Residents can enjoy a range of recreational facilities, including an infinity swimming pool with views, a fitness centre, children's play areas, multipurpose rooms, landscaped gardens and a yoga deck. The wider Rashid Yachts & Marina community provides access to a full-service marina, waterfront promenade, retail outlets, dining options and nearby leisure attractions, including the QE2 floating hotel.
Pier Point also benefits from road connectivity to major destinations across Dubai. Sheikh Zayed Road is approximately 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport around 15 minutes away, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek Harbour approximately 20 minutes away, subject to traffic conditions. With its waterfront setting, contemporary residences and range of apartment and townhouse options, Pier Point offers an appealing choice for families, end-users and investors seeking marina-side living in Dubai.

The Concept: Sharjah's Premier Walkable Community Nama 3 is located within Zone 3 of Al Mamsha Raseel, a visionary project designed by the Alef Group. This district is celebrated as the first fully integrated walkable community in Sharjah. The design philosophy centers on a 'car-free' environment at the ground level, prioritizing pedestrian safety, air quality, and social interaction. Imagine stepping out of your luxury tower directly onto beautifully landscaped walkways, where high-end retail stores, artisanal cafes, and essential services are all within a few minutes' stroll. This layout creates a harmonious balance between the privacy of residential life and the energy of a bustling commercial hub. A Strategic Masterplan: Al Mamsha Raseel The Al Mamsha Raseel sector is strategically nestled along the E311 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road), the primary artery connecting the various Emirates. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Together, these three zones form a comprehensive ecosystem where residents can work, live, and play without ever needing to leave the neighborhood. Connectivity and Prime Location One of the most compelling features of this 1-bedroom apartment is its central location. Nama 3 offers residents a 'best of both worlds' scenario: the cultural and educational richness of Sharjah paired with the commercial proximity of Dubai. * Education and Commerce: The apartment is a mere 5 minutes away from University City of Sharjah, home to prestigious academic institutions, making it an ideal rental choice for faculty and graduate students. The Sharjah Industrial Area is also just 5 minutes away, catering to professionals working in the city's economic heart. * Retail and Leisure: For premium shopping and dining, the 06 Mall is reachable within a 5-minute drive. If you are looking for green spaces, the lush Dubai National Park is just a 10-minute commute. * Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Sharjah International Airport is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this a perfect residence for frequent travelers and international business professionals. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: This is the FashionTV Acacia two-bedroom to look at when the view matters. Positioned on the 10th floor, the residence faces the sea and pool and offers 143.19 m² of total space, including two broad balconies. The Type E plan separates 108.22 m² of interior living from 34.97 m² of outdoor space. A 5.5-by-7.6-metre living and dining room forms the centre of the home, while the kitchen remains clearly defined without being cut off from the main entertaining area. Both bedrooms are generously proportioned, with two full bathrooms, a guest powder room, dressing space and a dedicated store. The two balconies extend along the curved façade, creating separate outdoor zones rather than a token terrace. Combined with the upper-floor position and published sea-and-pool outlook, they give this residence a clear lifestyle advantage within the two-bedroom collection. FashionTV Acacia brings a distinctive design identity to Al Marjan Island. BNW Developments is delivering the project, with architecture by Conin International. The published interiors favour warm timber, quiet stone tones and layered lighting; all visuals remain illustrative, while final finishes, fixtures and any furnishing package must follow the signed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes an infinity pool, children's pool and play areas, landscaped gardens, a viewing deck, water features, a gymnasium, barbecue and fire-pit areas, family lounges, a café and signature restaurant spaces. Offered at AED 4,929,876, the residence follows the published 50/50 payment plan: 10% on booking, eight instalments of 5% through month 20, and the final 50% on completion. Expected handover is Q2 2028. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established coastal and resort corridor. Published project information places Al Marjan Boulevard about six minutes away, Wynn Al Marjan Island about seven minutes away and Al Hamra Mall about eleven minutes away. Drive times are indicative. Contact Bhavesh Koonja, REALTOR and Certified International Property Specialist, at Tropical Riviera International Realty for the latest availability confirmation, exact floor plan, payment schedule, contractual specifications and reservation documents. Pricing, availability and project details remain subject to developer confirmation and inventory release.

description: Shoreline at Al Marjan Island Beachfront Living by DAMAC Properties Shoreline at Al Marjan Island by DAMAC Properties sets a new benchmark for luxury coastal living in Ras Al Khaimah. Rising 16 storeys, this iconic development offers 13 bedroom beachfront apartments and 4 & 5 bedroom townhouses , designed to blend modern architecture with the tranquility of island life. Every residence features panoramic sea and island views , elegant interiors, and direct private beach access , creating a resort-style lifestyle from the comfort of home. The project is enriched with signature amenities including an infinity pool, Aqua Oasis, Bamboo Forest, Zen Garden, Sunset Bar, and beautifully landscaped promenades. Shoreline also introduces unique lifestyle experiences with Floating Cabanas, Floating Bars , and a variety of water sports such as jet skiing, kayaking, and windsurfing. Through a special collaboration with artist Vincent Faudemer, the development features his iconic Babolex sculpturesadding a distinctive artistic element throughout the property. Perfectly positioned on Al Marjan Island, residents enjoy seamless access to Dubai, nearby retail destinations, fine dining, luxury resorts, and leisure attractionsmaking it the ultimate address for elevated seaside living. Key Features & Amenities Private beachfront access & infinity pool Adult and kids pools, Aqua Oasis, Floating Cabanas & Bar Rooftop Zen Garden, Sunset Bar & relaxation zones Bamboo Forest, landscaped promenades & jogging paths Fully equipped gym, spa & water sports (jet skiing, kayaking, windsurfing) Kids play areas, retail & dining options nearby Premium interiors with unobstructed sea and island views A perfect fusion of luxury, recreation & coastal serenity Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) can be a strong UAE real-estate investment opportunity , particularly if you're looking for capital appreciation + rental income over a 37 year horizon . Why RAK is attractive in 2026 Wynn Al Marjan Island is a major catalyst The USD 5.1 billion Wynn Al Marjan Island resort is targeted to open in 2027. It is expected to bring tourism, jobs, hospitality and additional demand for nearby residential property. Property prices are still relatively lower than Dubai You can often enter waterfront and resort communities at prices below comparable Dubai locations, giving investors a lower entry point. Strong recent price growth Al Marjan Island recorded around 21% year-on-year growth in average price per sq ft by early 2026, according to Khaleej Times. Tourism is expanding RAK is targeting 3.5 million annual visitors by 2030 , compared with around 1.3 million in 2024. More visitors can support hotels, holiday homes, restaurants, retail and residential demand. More international investment CBRE reports that RAK attracted more than USD 10 billion of greenfield FDI in 2025 , representing nearly a third of the UAE's total greenfield FDI value. Waterfront lifestyle + limited prime locations Areas such as Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab and Al Hamra Village combine beaches, resorts and lifestyle amenities, making them more attractive for both end-users and tourists. CBRE notes that prime coastal apartments have reached a new cyclical peak. Potential for rental income Waterfront and hospitality-oriented properties can benefit from both long-term tenants and holiday-home demand.
